title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION NINE OF ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-THREE AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE, TOY STRIKING OUT THE REQUIREMENT RELATIVE TO INDORSING PROVINCIAL WARRANTS.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION NINE OF ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-THREE AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE, TOY STRIKING OUT THE REQUIREMENT RELATIVE TO INDORSING PROVINCIAL WARRANTS.

text.en:
Section nine of Act Numbered Eighty-three, as amended by Act Numbered One hundred and
thirty-three, is hereby further amended by striking out of paragraph (e) of said section the words "duly
indorsed by the payee named therein, shall be Ms vouchers for their payment," and inserting in lieu thereof
the following: "shall be attached to his vouchers for their payment," so that said paragraph (e) shall read as
"(e) He shall be the custodian of the funds of the province and shall pay no money out of the provincial
treasury except upon warrants drawn in accordance with law, which shall be attached to his vouchers for
their payment."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth. nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 24, 1905
